src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 4]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if grid[r][c] != 4:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
prog.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

exec(src,ns)

out=transform(demo)
print('demo matches',out[3][1]==2, sum(v==2 for row in out for v in row))
